evals.name: fuzzy-idea-enters-brainstorming
evals.prompt: Use products-skills. I have an idea for an AI tool that turns messy meeting notes into follow-up tasks, but I am not sure what the first product should be.
evals.expected_output: Selects products-brainstorming, clarifies user/job/problem/success criteria, offers 2-3 options, recommends a first slice, and ends with a gate decision.

evals.name: rough-direction-enters-autoplan
evals.prompt: 走 products。我想做一个浏览器插件，自动总结网页并保存到 Notion。先判断这个方向值不值得继续。
evals.expected_output: Selects products-autoplan, evaluates value/scope/risks/verification, returns go/revise/stop, and names the smallest next action.

evals.name: clear-feature-enters-writing-plan-or-engineering-review
evals.prompt: Use products-skills to plan implementation for adding team workspaces, roles, and invite links to an existing SaaS dashboard.
evals.expected_output: Selects products-writing-plans or products-plan-eng-review, avoids direct implementation, defines scope, tasks, verification, risks, and next stage.

evals.name: bug-enters-investigation
evals.prompt: 用 products 看这个 bug：用户保存表单后偶尔回到空白页。不要直接补丁，先查根因。
evals.expected_output: Selects products-investigate before products-test-driven-development, asks for or describes reproduction evidence, separates symptoms from root cause, proposes minimal fix path and validation check.

evals.name: implemented-page-enters-qa
evals.prompt: Run products QA for the checkout page I just changed. I need to know whether the flow is ship-ready.
evals.expected_output: Selects products-qa, defines tested flow/environment/evidence, checks runtime or browser-style evidence expectations, and ends with ship-ready, fix-next, or revise.

evals.name: validated-work-enters-ship
evals.prompt: Use products to prepare the release handoff. The feature is implemented and tests plus browser QA passed.
evals.expected_output: Selects products-ship, summarizes change, tests, touched surfaces, risks, rollback or recovery note, handoff language, and release gate.

evals.name: short-answer-does-not-force-workflow
evals.prompt: What does TDD mean? Answer briefly.
evals.expected_output: Does not force the products workflow; gives a short direct answer because the request is not product delivery work.

evals.name: legacy-alias-still-routes-to-canonical-package
evals.prompt: Use product-skills for this feature idea: a tiny CRM for freelancers. Help me go from idea to product.
evals.expected_output: Routes to products-skills, optionally notes product-skills is a legacy alias, selects the right first stage, and uses the adaptive gate response shape.
